question: He do not know the answer.
correct: He does not know the answer.
explanation_hi: Singular subject 'He' के साथ auxiliary 'does' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: With singular subjects (he/she/it), use 'does' not 'do' in present tense.

question: She have completed her homework.
correct: She has completed her homework.
explanation_hi: Singular subject 'She' के साथ 'has' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'has' with singular subjects (he/she/it) in perfect tense.

question: Neither of the boys are present today.
correct: Neither of the boys is present today.
explanation_hi: 'Neither of' के साथ singular verb आता है।
explanation_en: 'Neither of' always takes a singular verb.

question: One of my friends are preparing for SSC.
correct: One of my friends is preparing for SSC.
explanation_hi: Subject 'One' singular है; verb singular होगी।
explanation_en: The subject is 'one' (singular), so use singular verb 'is'.

question: He is senior than me in experience.
correct: He is senior to me in experience.
explanation_hi: Latin-origin comparatives (senior, junior, superior, inferior) के साथ 'to' आता है।
explanation_en: Latin-origin comparatives take 'to' not 'than'.

question: She is good in Mathematics.
correct: She is good at Mathematics.
explanation_hi: किसी skill या subject में निपुणता के लिए 'good at' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'good at' for skills and academic subjects.

question: The teacher discussed about the chapter.
correct: The teacher discussed the chapter.
explanation_hi: 'Discuss' transitive verb है; इसके बाद 'about' नहीं आता।
explanation_en: 'Discuss' is transitive; do not use 'about' after it.

question: He did not went to school yesterday.
correct: He did not go to school yesterday.
explanation_hi: 'Did' के बाद verb की base form (first form) आती है।
explanation_en: After auxiliary 'did', always use the base form of the verb.

question: She has wrote a beautiful poem.
correct: She has written a beautiful poem.
explanation_hi: Present perfect में past participle (third form) प्रयोग होती है।
explanation_en: Use past participle (written) not past tense (wrote) in perfect tense.

question: He is knowing the truth.
correct: He knows the truth.
explanation_hi: 'Know' stative verb है; इसे continuous tense में प्रयोग नहीं करते।
explanation_en: Stative verbs (know, believe, want, like) are not used in continuous tense.

question: She resembles with her mother.
correct: She resembles her mother.
explanation_hi: 'Resemble' transitive verb है; इसके बाद preposition नहीं आता।
explanation_en: 'Resemble' is transitive; do not use any preposition after it.

question: He ordered for tea.
correct: He ordered tea.
explanation_hi: 'Order' transitive verb है; 'for' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Order' is transitive; do not use 'for' before the object.

question: She prefers tea than coffee.
correct: She prefers tea to coffee.
explanation_hi: 'Prefer' के साथ comparison में 'to' आता है, 'than' नहीं।
explanation_en: 'Prefer' takes 'to' in comparisons, not 'than'.

question: The news are very shocking.
correct: The news is very shocking.
explanation_hi: 'News' uncountable singular noun है।
explanation_en: 'News' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb.

question: Mathematics are my favorite subject.
correct: Mathematics is my favorite subject.
explanation_hi: '-ics' ending subjects (Mathematics, Physics, Economics) singular verb लेते हैं।
explanation_en: Subjects ending in '-ics' take singular verbs.

question: Each of the students have a notebook.
correct: Each of the students has a notebook.
explanation_hi: 'Each of' के साथ singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'Each of' always takes a singular verb.

question: The sceneries of Kashmir are beautiful.
correct: The scenery of Kashmir is beautiful.
explanation_hi: 'Scenery' uncountable noun है; इसका plural नहीं बनता।
explanation_en: 'Scenery' is uncountable; it has no plural form.

question: He is suffering with fever.
correct: He is suffering from fever.
explanation_hi: 'Suffer' के साथ preposition 'from' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'from' after 'suffer'; the correct phrase is 'suffer from'.

question: I am going to home now.
correct: I am going home now.
explanation_hi: 'Home' adverb की तरह प्रयोग होता है; इसके पहले 'to' नहीं आता।
explanation_en: 'Home' functions as an adverb of place; do not use 'to' before it.

question: The teacher as well as the students are present.
correct: The teacher as well as the students is present.
explanation_hi: 'As well as' से जुड़े subjects में verb पहले (main) subject के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: When subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject.

question: No sooner did he reached than it started raining.
correct: No sooner did he reach than it started raining.
explanation_hi: 'Did' के बाद verb की base form आती है।
explanation_en: After 'did', always use the base form of the verb.

question: She is one of the best singer in the class.
correct: She is one of the best singers in the class.
explanation_hi: 'One of the' के बाद plural noun आता है।
explanation_en: After 'one of the', always use a plural noun.

question: The police has arrested the thief.
correct: The police have arrested the thief.
explanation_hi: 'Police' collective noun है जो plural verb लेता है।
explanation_en: 'Police' is always treated as a plural noun in standard British English.

question: He is addicted with smoking.
correct: He is addicted to smoking.
explanation_hi: 'Addicted' के साथ 'to' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'addicted to'; do not use 'with'.

question: The train is preferable than the bus.
correct: The train is preferable to the bus.
explanation_hi: Latin-origin adjective 'preferable' के साथ 'to' आता है।
explanation_en: 'Preferable' takes 'to', not 'than'.

question: He is married with a doctor.
correct: He is married to a doctor.
explanation_hi: 'Married' के साथ 'to' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'married to'; do not use 'with'.

question: I look forward to meet you.
correct: I look forward to meeting you.
explanation_hi: 'Look forward to' में 'to' preposition है; इसके बाद gerund आता है।
explanation_en: 'To' in 'look forward to' is a preposition, so use gerund (-ing form) after it.

question: He prevented me to enter the room.
correct: He prevented me from entering the room.
explanation_hi: 'Prevent' के साथ 'from + gerund' structure आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'prevent someone from + gerund'; not 'prevent someone to + infinitive'.

question: She is capable to solve this problem.
correct: She is capable of solving this problem.
explanation_hi: 'Capable' के साथ 'of + gerund' structure आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'capable of + gerund'; not 'capable to + infinitive'.

question: The child was absent since Monday.
correct: The child has been absent since Monday.
explanation_hi: 'Since' के साथ present perfect (या perfect continuous) tense आता है।
explanation_en: Use present perfect or perfect continuous tense with 'since'.

question: One should keep their promises.
correct: One should keep one's promises.
explanation_hi: 'One' के साथ possessive pronoun 'one's' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'one's' as the possessive pronoun when the subject is 'one'.

question: Neither Ram nor his friends was present.
correct: Neither Ram nor his friends were present.
explanation_hi: 'Neither...nor' में verb nearest subject (friends-plural) के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.

question: She asked me where was I going.
correct: She asked me where I was going.
explanation_hi: Indirect speech में subject + verb order (statement order) आता है।
explanation_en: In indirect speech, use statement word order (subject + verb), not question order.

question: The furniture are very costly.
correct: The furniture is very costly.
explanation_hi: 'Furniture' uncountable noun है; singular verb लेता है।
explanation_en: 'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb.

question: He is working here since 2020.
correct: He has been working here since 2020.
explanation_hi: Ongoing action जो 'since' से शुरू हुई; present perfect continuous चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use present perfect continuous ('has been working') with 'since' for ongoing actions.

question: I have no any money.
correct: I have no money.
explanation_hi: 'No' और 'any' एक साथ double negative बनाते हैं।
explanation_en: Do not use 'no' and 'any' together; it creates a double negative.

question: He returned back from office late.
correct: He returned from office late.
explanation_hi: 'Return' में वापस आने का अर्थ पहले से होता है; 'back' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Return' already implies coming back; 'back' is redundant.

question: The teacher emphasized on discipline.
correct: The teacher emphasized discipline.
explanation_hi: 'Emphasize' transitive verb है; 'on' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Emphasize' is transitive; do not add 'on' after it.

question: He is more taller than his brother.
correct: He is taller than his brother.
explanation_hi: Double comparative ('more taller') गलत है।
explanation_en: Do not use 'more' with a word that is already in comparative form.

question: This is the most unique painting.
correct: This painting is unique.
explanation_hi: 'Unique' absolute adjective है; इसका comparative/superlative नहीं बनता।
explanation_en: 'Unique' is an absolute adjective; it cannot be compared.

question: The meeting will held tomorrow.
correct: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
explanation_hi: Passive voice में modal के बाद 'be + past participle' चाहिए।
explanation_en: In passive voice, use 'will be + past participle'.

question: She insisted to go there.
correct: She insisted on going there.
explanation_hi: 'Insist' के बाद 'on + gerund' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'insist on + gerund'; not 'insist to + infinitive'.

question: He is afraid from dogs.
correct: He is afraid of dogs.
explanation_hi: 'Afraid' के साथ 'of' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'afraid of'; do not use 'from'.

question: The principal congratulated me for my success.
correct: The principal congratulated me on my success.
explanation_hi: 'Congratulate' के साथ 'on' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'congratulate someone on something'; not 'for'.

question: The boy was punished of his mistake.
correct: The boy was punished for his mistake.
explanation_hi: 'Punish' के साथ 'for' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'punished for'; do not use 'of'.

question: He is jealous from his brother.
correct: He is jealous of his brother.
explanation_hi: 'Jealous' के साथ 'of' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'jealous of'; do not use 'from'.

question: She is fond for music.
correct: She is fond of music.
explanation_hi: 'Fond' के साथ 'of' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'fond of'; do not use 'for'.

question: The teacher distributed books between the students.
correct: The teacher distributed books among the students.
explanation_hi: दो से अधिक लोगों के बीच 'among' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'among' for more than two people; 'between' is for exactly two.

question: The river overflows on rainy season.
correct: The river overflows in the rainy season.
explanation_hi: Seasons के साथ 'in' और definite article 'the' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'in' with seasons; also add 'the' before 'rainy season'.

question: She is an university student.
correct: She is a university student.
explanation_hi: 'University' consonant sound /j/ से शुरू होता है; 'a' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'University' begins with a consonant /j/ sound; use 'a' not 'an'.

question: He gave me an useful advice.
correct: He gave me useful advice.
explanation_hi: 'Useful' consonant sound /j/ से शुरू होता है; साथ ही 'advice' uncountable है।
explanation_en: 'Useful' begins with consonant sound /j/, so 'a' not 'an'; also 'advice' is uncountable.

question: He is best player in the team.
correct: He is the best player in the team.
explanation_hi: Superlative adjective से पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before superlative adjectives.

question: She plays piano very well.
correct: She plays the piano very well.
explanation_hi: Musical instruments के पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before musical instruments.

question: Sun rises in east.
correct: The sun rises in the east.
explanation_hi: Unique objects और directions के पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before unique objects (sun, moon) and compass directions.

question: He is an honest man.
correct: He is an honest man.
explanation_hi: 'Honest' में 'H' silent है; vowel sound /o/ से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an' सही है। ✅
explanation_en: This sentence is correct. 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound; 'an' is correct.

question: She is a MA student.
correct: She is an MA student.
explanation_hi: Abbreviation 'MA' vowel sound /em/ से शुरू होता है; 'an' आता है।
explanation_en: Abbreviation 'MA' begins with vowel sound /em/; use 'an'.

question: He returned after the hour.
correct: He returned after an hour.
explanation_hi: 'Hour' silent 'H' से शुरू होता है; vowel sound है; 'an' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'Hour' has a silent 'H' and begins with a vowel sound; use 'an'.

question: She is teacher by profession.
correct: She is a teacher by profession.
explanation_hi: Profession बताते समय singular countable noun से पहले 'a/an' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'a/an' before a singular countable noun when stating a profession.

question: Wisdom is an essential quality.
correct: Wisdom is an essential quality.
explanation_hi: यह sentence सही है।
explanation_en: This sentence is correct. 'Essential' begins with a vowel sound; 'an' is correct.

question: You should to attend the class.
correct: You should attend the class.
explanation_hi: Modal verbs के बाद bare infinitive (to के बिना) आता है।
explanation_en: Modal verbs are followed by bare infinitive; do not use 'to' after them.

question: She might to come tomorrow.
correct: She might come tomorrow.
explanation_hi: Modal 'might' के बाद bare infinitive आता है।
explanation_en: Use bare infinitive after modal 'might'; do not add 'to'.

question: He must to complete the assignment.
correct: He must complete the assignment.
explanation_hi: Modal 'must' के बाद bare infinitive आता है।
explanation_en: Use bare infinitive after modal 'must'; do not add 'to'.

question: He should has completed the work.
correct: He should have completed the work.
explanation_hi: Past obligation के लिए 'should have + past participle' structure आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'should have + past participle' for past unfulfilled obligation.

question: She might have went there.
correct: She might have gone there.
explanation_hi: Perfect modal में 'have + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Use past participle 'gone' not past tense 'went' in perfect modal.

question: You ought attend the meeting.
correct: You ought to attend the meeting.
explanation_hi: 'Ought' के बाद हमेशा 'to' आता है।
explanation_en: 'Ought' always takes 'to'; use 'ought to + infinitive'.

question: He need not to worry.
correct: He need not worry.
explanation_hi: Modal 'need' (negative) के बाद bare infinitive आता है; 'to' नहीं।
explanation_en: When 'need' is used as a modal in negative, use 'need not + bare infinitive'.

question: He told that he was tired.
correct: He said that he was tired.
explanation_hi: 'Tell' के बाद object आना जरूरी है; बिना object के 'said that' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'Tell' must have an object (tell someone); without object, use 'said that'.

question: She said me to come early.
correct: She told me to come early.
explanation_hi: Command indirect speech में 'told someone to + infinitive' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'told me to' for reported commands; 'said me to' is incorrect.

question: He said that he will come tomorrow.
correct: He said that he would come the next day.
explanation_hi: Past reporting में 'will' → 'would' और 'tomorrow' → 'the next day' बदलता है।
explanation_en: In reported speech with past reporting verb, 'will' becomes 'would' and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.

question: She asked that where he lived.
correct: She asked where he lived.
explanation_hi: Indirect question में 'that' नहीं आता।
explanation_en: Do not use 'that' before question words in indirect speech.

question: The teacher advised me that I should rest.
correct: The teacher advised me to rest.
explanation_hi: Advice indirect speech में 'advised someone to + infinitive' बनती है।
explanation_en: For reported advice, use 'advised someone to + infinitive'.

question: He told me that he is ill.
correct: He told me that he was ill.
explanation_hi: Past reporting verb के साथ tense back-shift होता है।
explanation_en: When the reporting verb is past, shift the tense back (is → was).

question: The work is being did by him.
correct: The work is being done by him.
explanation_hi: Passive voice में past participle (done) आता है; 'did' नहीं।
explanation_en: Use past participle 'done' in passive voice, not past tense 'did'.

question: The letter has been wrote by her.
correct: The letter has been written by her.
explanation_hi: Perfect passive में 'been + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Use past participle 'written' in perfect passive construction.

question: The thief was catched by police.
correct: The thief was caught by the police.
explanation_hi: 'Catch' का past participle 'caught' है।
explanation_en: The past participle of 'catch' is 'caught', not 'catched'.

question: The match is been played.
correct: The match is being played.
explanation_hi: Present continuous passive में 'is being + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Present continuous passive: 'is being + past participle'.

question: She is known by everyone.
correct: She is known to everyone.
explanation_hi: Mental state verbs passive में 'to' लेते हैं।
explanation_en: Use 'known to' not 'known by' for mental state verbs in passive.

question: If he will study hard, he will pass.
correct: If he studies hard, he will pass.
explanation_hi: Type 1 conditional में 'if clause' में simple present आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 1 conditional, use simple present in the 'if-clause', not 'will'.

question: If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
correct: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
explanation_hi: Type 2 conditional में 'if clause' में simple past आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 2 conditional, use simple past in the 'if-clause', not 'would'.

question: If he had studied, he will have passed.
correct: If he had studied, he would have passed.
explanation_hi: Type 3 conditional में 'would have + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 3 conditional, use 'would have + past participle' in the main clause.

question: Unless you will study, you will fail.
correct: Unless you study, you will fail.
explanation_hi: 'Unless' में negation पहले से होता है; 'will' नहीं जोड़ते।
explanation_en: 'Unless' already contains negation; use simple present in the unless-clause.

question: I wish I was rich.
correct: I wish I were rich.
explanation_hi: 'Wish' के बाद unreal condition में 'were' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'were' (not 'was') after 'wish' for unreal situations.

question: If I was you, I would refuse.
correct: If I were you, I would refuse.
explanation_hi: Hypothetical/unreal condition में 'were' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'were' (not 'was') in unreal or hypothetical conditions.

question: He talks as if he is the boss.
correct: He talks as if he were the boss.
explanation_hi: 'As if' के साथ unreal condition में 'were' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'were' after 'as if' for imaginary or unreal conditions.

question: Although he was tired, but he worked.
correct: Although he was tired, he worked.
explanation_hi: 'Although' और 'but' एक साथ नहीं आते।
explanation_en: Do not use 'but' with 'although'; they both express contrast and are redundant together.

question: Since he was ill therefore he stayed home.
correct: Since he was ill, he stayed home.
explanation_hi: 'Since' और 'therefore' एक साथ नहीं आते।
explanation_en: Do not use 'therefore' with 'since'; they both convey cause and are redundant.

question: Though she tried hard, yet she failed.
correct: Though she tried hard, she failed.
explanation_hi: 'Though' के साथ 'yet' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: Do not use 'yet' with 'though'; they serve the same contrastive purpose.

question: Not only he plays well but also he is a good captain.
correct: Not only does he play well but he is also a good captain.
explanation_hi: 'Not only' sentence शुरू में आने पर inversion होता है।
explanation_en: When 'not only' begins a sentence, use subject-auxiliary inversion.

question: He is too weak that he cannot walk.
correct: He is too weak to walk.
explanation_hi: 'Too...to' structure में 'that' नहीं आता।
explanation_en: Use 'too + adjective + to + infinitive'; do not use 'that'.

question: Both he as well as his friend is wrong.
correct: Both he and his friend are wrong.
explanation_hi: 'Both' के साथ 'and' आता है, 'as well as' नहीं।
explanation_en: 'Both' is paired with 'and'; do not use 'as well as' with 'both'.

question: She sings very beautiful.
correct: She sings very beautifully.
explanation_hi: Verb को modify करने के लिए adverb चाहिए, adjective नहीं।
explanation_en: Use adverb 'beautifully' to modify the verb 'sings'.

question: He drives the car very careless.
correct: He drives the car very carelessly.
explanation_hi: Verb modify करने के लिए adverb (-ly form) आता है।
explanation_en: Use adverb 'carelessly' to modify the verb 'drives'.

question: I feel badly about the incident.
correct: I feel bad about the incident.
explanation_hi: Linking verb 'feel' के बाद adjective आता है, adverb नहीं।
explanation_en: Use adjective 'bad' after the linking verb 'feel', not adverb 'badly'.

question: She looks beautifully.
correct: She looks beautiful.
explanation_hi: Linking verb 'looks' के बाद adjective आता है।
explanation_en: Use adjective 'beautiful' after linking verbs like 'looks', 'seems', 'appears'.

question: The younger of the three sisters is Meera.
correct: The youngest of the three sisters is Meera.
explanation_hi: तीन या अधिक के लिए superlative degree प्रयोग होती है।
explanation_en: Use superlative (youngest) when comparing three or more; comparative is for two.

question: This is the most worst performance.
correct: This is the worst performance.
explanation_hi: 'Worst' पहले से superlative है; 'most' जोड़ना double superlative है।
explanation_en: 'Worst' is already superlative; do not add 'most'.

question: He is the most cleverest boy in class.
correct: He is the cleverest boy in class.
explanation_hi: 'Cleverest' पहले से superlative है; 'most' जोड़ना double superlative है।
explanation_en: Do not use 'most' with a word that is already in superlative form.

question: She is more better than him.
correct: She is better than him.
explanation_hi: 'Better' पहले से comparative है; 'more' जोड़ना गलत है।
explanation_en: Do not use 'more' with a word already in comparative form.

question: This is the better of the three options.
correct: This is the best of the three options.
explanation_hi: तीन या अधिक के बीच superlative degree प्रयोग होती है।
explanation_en: Use superlative 'best' when comparing three or more options.

question: He is taller than any boy in the class.
correct: He is taller than any other boy in the class.
explanation_hi: Same group comparison में 'any other' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'any other' when comparing a member within the same group.

question: She is a doctor, isn't it?
correct: She is a doctor, isn't she?
explanation_hi: Question tag में subject pronoun main clause से मिलना चाहिए।
explanation_en: The pronoun in a question tag must match the subject of the main clause.

question: Let us go, isn't it?
correct: Let us go, shall we?
explanation_hi: 'Let us' (suggestion) के साथ 'shall we?' tag आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'shall we?' as the question tag for suggestions starting with 'let us'.

question: He can swim, can't it?
correct: He can swim, can't he?
explanation_hi: Tag में pronoun main clause के subject से मिलना चाहिए।
explanation_en: The tag must use the correct subject pronoun 'he'.

question: He used to play cricket, used he not?
correct: He used to play cricket, didn't he?
explanation_hi: 'Used to' के साथ question tag 'didn't he?' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'didn't he?' as the question tag for 'used to' structures.

question: Nobody came, did he?
correct: Nobody came, did they?
explanation_hi: Negative indefinite (nobody) के साथ plural tag 'they' आता है।
explanation_en: With negative indefinites like 'nobody', use plural 'they' in the question tag.

question: She likes singing, dancing and to read.
correct: She likes singing, dancing and reading.
explanation_hi: Coordinate elements parallel form में होने चाहिए।
explanation_en: Maintain parallel structure; all items should be in the same grammatical form (gerunds).

question: He is intelligent, hardworking and has honesty.
correct: He is intelligent, hardworking and honest.
explanation_hi: Coordinate adjectives parallel form में होनी चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use parallel adjective forms; 'honest' not 'has honesty'.

question: She not only sings but also is dancing.
correct: She not only sings but also dances.
explanation_hi: 'Not only...but also' structure parallel होना चाहिए।
explanation_en: Both parts of 'not only...but also' must be in the same grammatical form.

question: Walking down the street, the trees looked beautiful.
correct: Walking down the street, I noticed the trees looked beautiful.
explanation_hi: Participial phrase का subject main clause के subject से मिलना चाहिए।
explanation_en: The participial phrase must relate to the subject of the main clause, not 'trees'.

question: Having finished the work, the TV was switched on.
correct: Having finished the work, he switched on the TV.
explanation_hi: Dangling participle: participial phrase का subject missing है।
explanation_en: The doer of 'having finished' must be the subject of the main clause.

question: He only eats vegetables.
correct: He eats only vegetables.
explanation_hi: 'Only' को उस शब्द के ठीक पहले रखना चाहिए जिसे वह modify करे।
explanation_en: Place 'only' immediately before the word it modifies.

question: There are less students today.
correct: There are fewer students today.
explanation_hi: Countable noun के लिए 'fewer' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'fewer' with countable nouns; 'less' is for uncountable nouns.

question: He has much friends here.
correct: He has many friends here.
explanation_hi: Countable noun के साथ 'many' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'many' with countable nouns; 'much' is for uncountable nouns.

question: There is a little water in the bottle.
correct: There is little water in the bottle.
explanation_hi: 'A little' का अर्थ 'थोड़ा पर पर्याप्त' है; 'little' = 'बहुत कम' (नकारात्मक अर्थ)।
explanation_en: 'A little' means some (positive); 'little' means hardly any (negative). Context determines choice.

question: She has a few money.
correct: She has little money.
explanation_hi: 'Few' countable nouns के साथ और 'little' uncountable nouns के साथ आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'few' with countable nouns and 'little' with uncountable nouns like 'money'.

question: I have seen him yesterday.
correct: I saw him yesterday.
explanation_hi: Definite past time ('yesterday') के साथ simple past आता है।
explanation_en: Use simple past with definite past time expressions like 'yesterday'.

question: She has completed the work two days ago.
correct: She completed the work two days ago.
explanation_hi: 'Two days ago' definite past time expression है; simple past चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use simple past with 'ago'; do not use present perfect.

question: When I will reach home, I will call you.
correct: When I reach home, I will call you.
explanation_hi: Time clause में simple present आता है; 'will' नहीं।
explanation_en: Use simple present (not 'will') in time clauses starting with 'when', 'after', 'before'.

question: By the time she arrives, I will finish the work.
correct: By the time she arrives, I will have finished the work.
explanation_hi: 'By the time' के साथ future perfect आता है।
explanation_en: Use future perfect ('will have finished') with 'by the time'.

question: He is working here for five years.
correct: He has been working here for five years.
explanation_hi: Duration के साथ ongoing action के लिए present perfect continuous आता है।
explanation_en: Use present perfect continuous for ongoing actions over a period of time.

question: He rose the flag at dawn.
correct: He raised the flag at dawn.
explanation_hi: 'Raise' transitive verb है (object लेता है); 'rise' intransitive है।
explanation_en: 'Raise' is transitive (takes an object); 'rise' is intransitive.

question: She lied the book on the table.
correct: She laid the book on the table.
explanation_hi: 'Lay' (रखना) का past tense 'laid' है।
explanation_en: Past tense of 'lay' (to place) is 'laid'; 'lie' means to recline.

question: The effect of pollution affects health.
correct: The effects of pollution affect health.
explanation_hi: 'Effect' noun है; 'affect' verb है।
explanation_en: 'Effect' is a noun; 'affect' is a verb. Do not confuse them.

question: He is more elder than his brother.
correct: He is older than his brother.
explanation_hi: 'Elder' family comparison के लिए है; 'than' के साथ नहीं आता; 'older' प्रयोग करें।
explanation_en: 'Elder' cannot take 'than'; use 'older' for age comparisons.

question: She is the eldest of the two sisters.
correct: She is the elder of the two sisters.
explanation_hi: दो लोगों के लिए comparative (elder) प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use comparative 'elder' for two; superlative 'eldest' for three or more.

question: He denied to have taken the money.
correct: He denied having taken the money.
explanation_hi: 'Deny' के बाद gerund आता है, infinitive नहीं।
explanation_en: Use gerund after 'deny'; not infinitive.

question: She enjoys to dance.
correct: She enjoys dancing.
explanation_hi: 'Enjoy' के बाद gerund आता है, infinitive नहीं।
explanation_en: Use gerund after 'enjoy'; not infinitive.

question: The accused fled away from the scene.
correct: The accused fled from the scene.
explanation_hi: 'Flee/fled' में already away का अर्थ होता है; 'away' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Flee' already implies moving away; 'away' is redundant.

question: He made me to wait for an hour.
correct: He made me wait for an hour.
explanation_hi: Causative 'make' के बाद bare infinitive आता है।
explanation_en: Use bare infinitive (without 'to') after causative 'make'.

question: She had her hair to cut yesterday.
correct: She had her hair cut yesterday.
explanation_hi: Causative 'have' structure में bare infinitive (past participle) आता है।
explanation_en: Use past participle in causative 'have + object + past participle'.

question: He reached to the station on time.
correct: He reached the station on time.
explanation_hi: 'Reach' transitive verb है; object के पहले preposition नहीं आता।
explanation_en: 'Reach' is transitive; do not use 'to' before its object.

question: Please revert back to us soon.
correct: Please revert to us soon.
explanation_hi: 'Revert' में already वापस आने का अर्थ है; 'back' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Revert' already means to go back; 'back' is redundant.

question: The reason is because he was absent.
correct: The reason is that he was absent.
explanation_hi: 'The reason is because' grammatically incorrect है।
explanation_en: Use 'the reason is that'; do not say 'the reason is because'.

question: He can be able to solve this.
correct: He can solve this.
explanation_hi: 'Can' और 'be able to' एक साथ नहीं आते।
explanation_en: Do not combine 'can' with 'be able to'; they are both modals meaning the same thing.

question: He entered into the examination hall.
correct: He entered the examination hall.
explanation_hi: 'Enter' transitive verb है; 'into' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Enter' is transitive; do not use 'into' after it.

question: Scarcely had he left than it rained.
correct: Scarcely had he left when it rained.
explanation_hi: 'Scarcely' के साथ 'when' आता है, 'than' नहीं।
explanation_en: Use 'when' (not 'than') with 'scarcely'.

question: Hardly had I reached the station when the train left.
correct: Hardly had I reached the station when the train left.
explanation_hi: यह sentence पूरी तरह सही है।
explanation_en: This sentence is grammatically correct; 'hardly' + inversion + 'when' is the correct structure.

question: He is taller than all the boys in the class.
correct: He is taller than all the other boys in the class.
explanation_hi: जब person same group का हिस्सा हो तो 'all the other' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'all the other' when the person being compared is part of the same group.

question: No sooner he arrived than it rained.
correct: No sooner had he arrived than it rained.
explanation_hi: 'No sooner' sentence शुरू में आने पर auxiliary inversion होता है।
explanation_en: When 'no sooner' begins a sentence, use auxiliary inversion (had he, not he had).

question: Barely he finished when the bell rang.
correct: Barely had he finished when the bell rang.
explanation_hi: 'Barely' sentence शुरू में आने पर auxiliary inversion होता है।
explanation_en: Use auxiliary inversion when 'barely' starts a sentence.

question: The principal along with teachers were present.
correct: The principal along with teachers was present.
explanation_hi: 'Along with' से verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: Verb agrees with the first subject; 'along with' does not change verb number.

question: A pair of shoes are lying there.
correct: A pair of shoes is lying there.
explanation_hi: 'A pair of' singular unit है; singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'A pair of' is singular; use singular verb.

question: The committee are divided on this issue.
correct: The committee is divided on this issue.
explanation_hi: एक unit के रूप में collective noun singular verb लेता है।
explanation_en: When a collective noun acts as a single unit, use singular verb.

question: He suggested me to take rest.
correct: He suggested that I should take rest.
explanation_hi: 'Suggest' के बाद 'that-clause' आता है; direct infinitive नहीं।
explanation_en: Use 'suggest that + subject + should/verb'; not 'suggest someone to'.

question: She requested him that he should help her.
correct: She requested him to help her.
explanation_hi: Request indirect speech में 'requested someone to + infinitive' बनती है।
explanation_en: Use 'requested someone to + infinitive'; not 'that he should'.

question: She is very much fond of singing.
correct: She is very fond of singing.
explanation_hi: 'Very much' adjective के पहले नहीं आता; 'very' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'very' (not 'very much') before adjectives.

question: He is working in this company since last year.
correct: He has been working in this company since last year.
explanation_hi: 'Since' के साथ present perfect continuous tense आता है।
explanation_en: Use present perfect continuous tense with 'since' for ongoing actions.

question: The boy who's father is a doctor lives here.
correct: The boy whose father is a doctor lives here.
explanation_hi: 'Whose' possessive relative pronoun है; 'who's' = 'who is' — गलत है।
explanation_en: 'Whose' is the possessive relative pronoun; 'who's' means 'who is' and is incorrect here.

question: Between you and I, this is wrong.
correct: Between you and me, this is wrong.
explanation_hi: Preposition के बाद objective case (me) आता है।
explanation_en: Use objective case after prepositions; 'between you and me'.

question: She is the best of the two candidates.
correct: She is the better of the two candidates.
explanation_hi: दो के बीच तुलना में comparative degree आती है।
explanation_en: Use comparative degree when comparing exactly two things.
